== How to create an EMF Model Project with ecore model ==

*  1. * File-> New-> Other -> *Empty EMF Project* and give a name to your project.

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/0.Select_Empty_Emf_Project_Wizard.png

<br> 

*  2. * Open UNICASE perspective and right click on the package you want to generate ecore model from and select *Generate Ecore*.

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/2.GenerateEcoreModel.png

<br> 

*  3. *  Select model-Folder of your EMF Project and give name for your .ecore File.

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/2.2.SelectModelFolder.png

<br> 

*  4. * Change to Java perspective and refresh your EMF Project. You can see your .ecore file. Double click on them to open it in Ecore Editor.

*  5. *In Ecore Editor right click on your package and select *Load Ressource*. 

<br> 

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/4.Load_Source.png

<br>

*  6. * Click on *Browse Workspace* and select _org.unicase.model/model/model.ecore_.

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/5.Select_Org_Unicase_Model.png

<br> 

== How to set properties in ecore model ==

*  7. * Go to *Properties* with double click on class of your ecore package.
<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/6.Class_Properties_Select_To_Each_Class.png

<br> 

*  8. * Set to all classes *ESuperTypes* to _UnicaseModelELement_.
<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/7.Add_ESuper_Type_Unicase_Model_Element.png

<br> 


*  9. * Set Name to _yourPackageName_, NS Prefix to _org.unicase.model.yourPackageName_  and NS URI _http://org.unicase.model.yourPackageName_.(spaces in names are not allowed)

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/Ecore_Model_Property.png

<br> 

*  10. * Right click on your package and select *Validate* from the context menu.

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/8.Validate_Ecore_Model.png

<br> 


If your *Validate* was successfull you have made a correct ecore model.


== How to create generator model from ecore model ==

*  11. *Change to Java perspective.

*  12. * File-> New-> Other -> *EMF Generator Model*. 

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/9.Select_EmfGenerator_Model_Wizard.png

<br>
 
*  13. * Select in *EMF Generator* Window the _model_-Folder from 
your ecore project and set name for your generator model, for example _yourEcoreModelName.*genmodel*_. Filename must end with .genmodel.

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/10.Create_Genmodel.png

<br>

*  14. * Select _Ecore model_ by *Model Importer* window. In next *Ecore Import* window and click on *Browse workspace...*. 
<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/11.Select_Model_Importer.png

<br> 

*  15. * After clicking on *Browse workspace* you must select your ecore file.

<br> 

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/12.Select_Your_Own_Ecore_FIle.png

<br> 

*  16. * Select as *Root package* only your own package.

<br> 


http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/13.Package_Selection_Before.png

<br>

*  17 * Select as *Referenced Generator Model* all packages you see there.

<br> 


http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/14.Package_Selection_After.png

<br>

*  18. * Finish, your genmodel was created!


* 19. *Double click on your generator model (root element of the hierarchy) and you can set the properties on *Properties* View.


== How to set properties in generator model ==

*  20. * Set in the *Properties* _All_ -> _Base Package_ to org.unicase.model and click  save.

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/16.Set_Properties_All-_BasePackage.png

<br> 

*  21. * Double click on package element (child element of the hierarchy) and set in the properties following fields in this way:
   
   *All 
      * _Compilance Level_ - 5.0
      * _Copyright Fields_ - true
      * _Copyright Text_ - hier you should paste your copyright text

   * Edit
      * _Edit Directory_ - project_name/src

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/17.All+Edit_Properties.png

<br>

   * Editor
      * _Editor Directory_ - org.unicase.modelExample/src

   * Model
      * _Containment Proxies_ - true
      * _Model Directory_ - /org.unicase.modelExample/src

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/18.Editor_and_Model_Properties.png

<br>

   * Template & Merge
      * _Code Formatting_ - true

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/19.Template+Merge_Properties.png

<br>

=== How to generate model code ===

* 22. * Generate code from generator model.

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/20.Generate_Model_Code.png

<br>

* 22. * Finish, the code is generated.

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/21.Finished_Project.png

<br>

Now you have all elements of your unicase model as classes.
